title: BenchmarkDefinitions v1
description: Interface F (SPEC.md §4 F): the benchmarks investment-reviews keeps, as one generation: the broad-market list and each live thesis's candidate universe. A thesis benchmark is the equal-weighted basket of its candidates. A missing or invalid document leaves the last valid generation in force; it never means no benchmarks.

definitionsHash.description: The SHA-256, in lower-case hex, of the canonical JSON of {broadMarket, theses} (SPEC.md §4 F): an unchanged set of definitions is recognisably the same generation.

generatedAt.description: UTC, ISO 8601 with a Z suffix.

broadMarket.description: investment-reviews' BENCHMARKS, in its order. Never empty.

tag.description: Its region or asset class, e.g. "Benchmarks - US Equities"; the decision-outcomes basket is the US Equities subset.

theses.description: Each live thesis in briefs/thesis.json, in its order.
